description: React component for the login page of an e-commerce frontend application, handling user login via email and password, with navigation to other pages upon success.

methods.name: LoginPage
methods.description: React component that renders a login form, manages state for email, password, error messages, and handles form submission.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Asynchronous event handler for form submission, attempts to login user and navigate upon success, sets error message upon failure.
